servers.gmail: Read, search and send the user's email.
servers.calendar: The user's calendars: events, availability, invitations.
servers.drive: Files and folders in the user's cloud drive.
servers.maps: Places, directions and travel times anywhere in the world, by car, on foot, by bike or by public transport.
servers.memory: A general long-term memory for facts about the user, shared across every conversation and app.
servers.reminders: The user's reminders and to-do lists.
servers.rides: Book and price taxis and ride-hailing.
servers.rail_tickets: Search and buy train tickets across Great Britain.
servers.city_alerts: Civic alerts for the user's city: roadworks, events, strikes, public transport disruption.
servers.fitness: The user's workouts, sleep and recovery data.
servers.finance: The user's accounts, transactions and budgets.
servers.slack: The user's workspace messages and channels.

tools.name: gmail__search_threads
tools.description: Search the user's mailbox with Gmail query syntax and return matching threads, newest first. Use before reading or replying to anything.

query.description: Gmail search query, e.g. from:alice newer_than:7d

tools.name: gmail__get_thread
tools.description: Read every message in one thread, with senders, dates and bodies.

tools.name: gmail__get_message
tools.description: Read one message in full, including headers and attachment names.

tools.name: gmail__send_message
tools.description: Send a new email from the user's account. Confirm recipients and content with the user first.

tools.name: gmail__reply
tools.description: Reply within an existing thread, keeping its subject and recipients.

tools.name: gmail__create_draft
tools.description: Save a draft without sending it, for the user to review.

tools.name: gmail__list_labels
tools.description: List the mailbox's labels and their IDs.

tools.name: gmail__label_thread
tools.description: Add or remove labels on a thread.

tools.name: gmail__trash_thread
tools.description: Move a thread to the bin. Recoverable for 30 days.

tools.name: calendar__list_events
tools.description: List events in a time range on one calendar, in start order. Use it to answer what is on the user's schedule, including where each event is.

tools.name: calendar__create_event
tools.description: Create an event with a title, time, location and guests. Use it when the user asks to put something in their diary, including a trip or a commute block.

tools.name: calendar__update_event
tools.description: Change an existing event's time, place or guests.

tools.name: calendar__delete_event
tools.description: Delete an event and notify its guests.

tools.name: calendar__find_free_time
tools.description: Find gaps when the user, and optionally other people, are free.

tools.name: calendar__respond_to_event
tools.description: Accept, decline or tentatively accept an invitation.

tools.name: calendar__list_calendars
tools.description: List the calendars the user can see.

tools.name: drive__search_files
tools.description: Search file names and contents across the user's drive.

tools.name: drive__read_file
tools.description: Read a document, sheet or PDF as text.

tools.name: drive__create_file
tools.description: Create a new document or text file in a folder.

tools.name: drive__update_file
tools.description: Replace or append to a file's content.

tools.name: drive__share_file
tools.description: Share a file with people or by link.

tools.name: drive__list_recent
tools.description: List files the user opened or edited recently.

tools.name: drive__trash_file
tools.description: Move a file to the bin.

tools.name: notes__save_note
tools.description: Save a note for the user to find later. Use it whenever the user asks you to remember, jot down or keep something: an address, a preference, a plan, a list.

tools.name: notes__search_notes
tools.description: Find the user's saved notes by words or tag. Use it when the user asks what they saved or what you have noted for them.

tools.name: notes__get_note
tools.description: Read one note in full.

tools.name: notes__update_note
tools.description: Edit a note's title or body.

tools.name: notes__delete_note
tools.description: Delete a note permanently.

tools.name: notes__list_notebooks
tools.description: List the user's notebooks.

tools.name: maps__get_directions
tools.description: Step-by-step directions between two places by driving, walking, cycling or transit, with distance and duration. Works worldwide; transit covers buses, trains and metro where schedules are published.

tools.name: maps__get_travel_time
tools.description: Estimated travel time and distance between two places for one mode, with current traffic. Faster than directions when only the time matters.

tools.name: maps__search_places
tools.description: Find places by name or category near a location: stations, cafes, gyms, addresses.

tools.name: maps__place_details
tools.description: Opening hours, address, phone and reviews for one place.

tools.name: maps__geocode
tools.description: Turn an address or postcode into coordinates.

tools.name: maps__reverse_geocode
tools.description: Turn coordinates into the nearest address.

tools.name: maps__nearby_transit
tools.description: List public transport stops near a point with the lines that serve them.

tools.name: maps__save_place
tools.description: Save a place to the user's saved places list under a label such as Home or Work, so it can be used by name in directions.

tools.name: memory__remember_fact
tools.description: Store a fact about the user so every future conversation knows it: where they live, what they prefer, what they are working on. Use it when the user tells you something lasting about themselves.

category.description: profile, preference, work, health or other

tools.name: memory__recall
tools.description: Retrieve what is remembered about the user, optionally filtered by topic. Use it when the user asks what you know or have saved about them.

tools.name: memory__forget_fact
tools.description: Delete a remembered fact the user says is wrong or no longer true.

tools.name: memory__update_fact
tools.description: Correct a remembered fact.

tools.name: memory__list_categories
tools.description: List the categories of remembered facts and how many each holds.

tools.name: reminders__create_reminder
tools.description: Set a reminder for a time or place. Use it when the user wants to be told something later, such as when to leave.

tools.name: reminders__list_reminders
tools.description: List open reminders, soonest first.

tools.name: reminders__complete_reminder
tools.description: Mark a reminder done.

tools.name: reminders__delete_reminder
tools.description: Delete a reminder.

tools.name: reminders__create_list
tools.description: Create a new reminders list.

tools.name: reminders__snooze_reminder
tools.description: Push a reminder later.

tools.name: weather__get_forecast
tools.description: Hourly and daily forecast for a place.

tools.name: weather__get_current
tools.description: Current conditions at a place.

tools.name: weather__get_warnings
tools.description: Active severe weather warnings for a region.

tools.name: weather__get_air_quality
tools.description: Air quality index and pollutants at a place.

tools.name: rides__estimate_fare
tools.description: Price and pickup time estimates for a ride between two places.

tools.name: rides__request_ride
tools.description: Book a ride now. Charges the user's saved payment method; confirm first.

tools.name: rides__cancel_ride
tools.description: Cancel a booked ride. A fee may apply.

tools.name: rides__ride_status
tools.description: Where the booked car is and when it arrives.

tools.name: rides__list_saved_places
tools.description: The user's saved pickup places such as home and work.

tools.name: rail_tickets__search_fares
tools.description: Search train times and ticket prices between two stations in Great Britain for a date, with operators and changes.

tools.name: rail_tickets__get_fare_details
tools.description: Restrictions, validity and refund rules for one fare.

tools.name: rail_tickets__book_ticket
tools.description: Buy a ticket with the user's saved card. Confirm the fare and time first.

tools.name: rail_tickets__list_bookings
tools.description: The user's upcoming and past train bookings.

tools.name: rail_tickets__season_ticket_price
tools.description: Annual, monthly and weekly season ticket prices between two stations.

tools.name: rail_tickets__station_facilities
tools.description: Facilities at a station: step-free access, toilets, parking, staffing hours.

tools.name: city_alerts__get_transit_alerts
tools.description: Current public transport disruption notices for a city, from the city's open alerts feed: strikes, closures, severe delays.

tools.name: city_alerts__get_roadworks
tools.description: Planned and current roadworks and closures.

tools.name: city_alerts__get_events
tools.description: Large public events that affect travel and crowds.

tools.name: city_alerts__subscribe_alerts
tools.description: Subscribe the user to alerts for an area or line.

tools.name: city_alerts__get_air_alerts
tools.description: Pollution and pollen alerts for a city.

tools.name: fitness__get_recovery
tools.description: Today's recovery score and its drivers.

tools.name: fitness__list_workouts
tools.description: Workouts in a date range with strain and duration.

tools.name: fitness__get_sleep
tools.description: Sleep duration, stages and efficiency for a night.

tools.name: fitness__get_trends
tools.description: Weekly and monthly trends for a metric.

tools.name: fitness__log_activity
tools.description: Log an activity by hand.

tools.name: finance__list_transactions
tools.description: Transactions in a date range, optionally by account or category.

tools.name: finance__get_balance
tools.description: Current balance of one or all accounts.

tools.name: finance__spending_summary
tools.description: Spending by category for a period.

tools.name: finance__categorise_transaction
tools.description: Set or correct a transaction's category.

tools.name: finance__list_subscriptions
tools.description: Recurring payments detected in the accounts.

tools.name: finance__get_budget
tools.description: Budget against actual for a month.

tools.name: github__list_issues
tools.description: Issues in a repository, filterable by state and label.

tools.name: github__get_issue
tools.description: One issue with its comments.

tools.name: github__create_issue
tools.description: Open a new issue.

tools.name: github__list_pull_requests
tools.description: Pull requests in a repository.

tools.name: github__get_pull_request
tools.description: One pull request with its diff summary and checks.

tools.name: github__add_comment
tools.description: Comment on an issue or pull request.

tools.name: github__get_file
tools.description: Read a file from a repository at a ref.

tools.name: github__search_code
tools.description: Search code across repositories the user can read.

tools.name: slack__search_messages
tools.description: Search messages across channels and DMs.

tools.name: slack__post_message
tools.description: Post a message to a channel or person. Visible to others immediately.

tools.name: slack__list_channels
tools.description: Channels the user is in.

tools.name: slack__get_thread
tools.description: Read a thread's messages.

tools.name: slack__set_status
tools.description: Set the user's status text and emoji, for example Commuting.

tools.name: slack__list_unread
tools.description: Unread messages and mentions.
